detail.command: for f in src/courses/data/ancient-temple.ts src/courses/data/arctic-base.ts src/courses/data/volcano.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; for s in 1 2 3; do L=$(git show :$s:$f | wc -l); M=$(git show :$s:$f | awk '{ if (length($0)>m) m=length($0) } END { print m }'); echo "  stage$s: lines=$L maxlinelen=$M"; done; echo '  --- ours head ---'; git show :2:$f | head -12; done; echo '=== minified check across tree (long lines in src) ==='; git grep -n '.\{400,\}' -- 'src/**' | cut -c1-120
